title: ENDEX: The Levee Held, the River Is Falling

fields.resolution: ENDEX. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. It is 18:00 CDT, Saturday 24 April 2027. CFDI4 on the Route 38 bridge piers reads 23.0 ft and is falling. The levee held, and the boil at station 18+50 is ringed and running clear. This ends the exercise play.
finalState: CFDI4 is at 23.0 ft and falling. The crest was 23.5 ft at 05:45 Saturday. Under the 12:00 Saturday issuance the river falls below 19.0 ft late Monday and below flood stage on Wednesday.
The Levee and Drainage District No. 3 levee held. The ringed boil at 18+50 is running clear and stays under 24-hour patrol until the stage drops below 19.0 ft.
Pump Stations 1 and 2 are running and have fuel. The wastewater plant is in the state your bypass decision left it, and the Iowa DNR notice is on record.
Cedar Hollow stays closed until it has been inspected. The phased return plan for residents and Hollow Court Care Center is drafted.
Notifications to Iowa HSEMD, Iowa DNR and the Corps of Engineers are logged.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. That is the end of play. Please put down your radios, phones and printouts, and keep your decision logs and the River Status Board as they are. We will take a ten-minute break and then start the hot wash here in the EOC.
fields.hotWashMethod: Decision timeline: go through the River Status Board one issuance at a time and place each recorded decision against the forecast it rested on. Then do 3-Up, 3-Down for each role.
hotWashQuestions: Which forecast issuance did each decision rest on: the activation level, the Cedar Hollow order, and the Hollow Court move? Did we re-decide within the hour when the 18:00 Tuesday and 12:00 Wednesday material revisions came in?
Did we tie road closures to a stage, River Road at 15.0 ft and the Mill Street underpass at 17.0 ft, and close them before they flooded? Or did a motorist get there first?
Did our resource orders for bags, pumps, the flatbed and diesel name a quantity, a delivery point and a needed-by time? Which ones arrived too late?
How long did it take to answer the 18.2 ft radio story and the 'levee broke' post? Did our public messages give the measured stage and the right flood category?
When interior ponding reached the wastewater plant yard, what did the bypass decision rest on? Who notified Iowa DNR, and when?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect the decision logs, the printed River Status Board, the evaluator sheets and any ICS 213 messages before the break. Have the Phase 3 Cedar Hollow decision and its recorded time ready, because the timeline review starts there.
